queries.events: SELECT event_id, ticker, available_as_of, source_url, parent_event_id FROM public.events WHERE event_status = 'accepted' ORDER BY event_id
queries.snapshots: SELECT snapshot_id, ticker, signal_time, signal_label, evidence_event_ids, component_anatomy FROM public.signal_snapshots WHERE ticker = ANY(%s) AND signal_time >= %s AND signal_time < %s ORDER BY snapshot_id
queries.track_record: SELECT snapshot_id, ticker, signal_date, (return_1d IS NOT NULL) AS k1, (return_5d IS NOT NULL) AS k5, (return_20d IS NOT NULL) AS k20 FROM public.track_record WHERE ticker = ANY(%s) AND signal_date >= %s AND signal_date <= %s ORDER BY ticker, signal_date, snapshot_id
